chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abi Ayyub, from Burayd al-'Ijli, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
For the male organ of the boy, the diyah is complete.

key_terms.الدِّيَةُ: financial compensation due for bodily injury or killing

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the diyah for injury to the male organ of a boy in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury compensation. It states that in the case of the male organ of a boy, the full diyah is due.
